text: In 2003, three elite mercenaries known as the Hyenas of Bangui are flying a Mexican drug lord and a case of gold out of Bissau when [a sabotaged fuel leak|trigger|a sudden accident or attack] forces them down in Senegal's Sine-Saloum. Posing as gold miners, they hide at an isolated delta resort run by Omar, where a deaf woman named Awa already knows who they are. Their leader Chaka has come for [a reckoning with Omar|wants|revenge for a wrong], and when night abruptly turns to day, [swarming spirits that hunt by sound|rules|how it hunts] escape [the curse Omar kept bound|origin|old things disturbed].
